title: Ganda Qarqara Dhaddachaa
intro: Ganda qarqara galaanaa, bakka sagalee dalgaa hasaasa ummata dagatamee wajjin wal makamu keessatti of argatta. Ajajni boqonnaa isaaniif kenname, araadni isaanii garuu adabbii ammallee sagalee callisee dubbatamutti isaan geesseera. Eenyu akka turan saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Qarqara qarqara jiraachaa kan turre siʼa taʼu, guyyaa boqonnaa akka kabajnu ajajni nuuf kenname.
Guyyaa sana qurxummiin baay’inaan nutti dhufu ture, garuu fudhachuun nu dhorkamee ture.
Gariin keenya irra daddarbaa irraa akeekkachiisan, kaan garuu akkanumatti qurxummii qabuuf shira xaxan.
Ajaja qulqulluu cabsinee adabbii cimaa ofitti fidne.
Adabbiin keenya jijjiirama bifa balleessuu fi salphina nu dhiise ture.
Gara hantuutaatti jijjiiramne, mallattoo namoota booda dhufan hundaaf taʼu.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
